tasks.task: Implement the LRUCache class in src/h1_lru.js per its spec: O(1) get/put, get counts as a use, put updates count as a use, evict least-recently-used when over capacity, get returns -1 if absent. Make node test/h1_lru.test.js pass.

Fix the bugs in mergeIntervals in src/h2_intervals.js so node test/h2_intervals.test.js passes: it must sort by start first, merge touching intervals (<= boundary), and must not mutate the input arrays.

Add TTL expiry to the Store class in src/h3_store.js: set(k,v,ttlMs) expires the key ttlMs after set (using this.now()); expired keys are absent for get/has/size and cleaned lazily; non-TTL keys never expire; re-set refreshes ttl. Do not break existing behaviour. Make node test/h3_store.test.js pass.

Implement the token-bucket RateLimiter in src/h4_ratelimiter.js per spec: starts full, continuous fractional refill at refillPerSec capped at capacity, tryRemove(n,now) deducts only if enough tokens (else false, no deduction), available(now) returns current tokens. Make node test/h4_ratelimiter.test.js pass.
